plugin_desc: Raritan PX / PX2 / PX3 rack PDU SNMP child template for devices under Raritan PEN 13742.6. Interface traffic is supplied by the shared NetworkService SNMP IF-MIB floor rather than a plugin-side ifHC expansion. Proven PDU2 private increments are measurementsInletSensorValue scaled by inletSensorDecimalDigits for rmsCurrent, rmsVoltage and activePower, plus measurementsExternalSensorValue scaled by externalSensorDecimalDigits for external temperature and humidity. CPU and memory scalars are not invented. PDU1 13742.4 and outlet measurement tables are not collected. Supported brands/models - Raritan PX family PDUs that expose the PDU2 tree and standard IF-MIB.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: pdu_inlet_current_amps
metrics.description: Per-inlet RMS current in amperes from PDU2 measurementsInletSensorValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.13742.6.5.2.3.1.4) with inletSensorDecimalDigits (1.3.6.1.4.1.13742.6.3.3.4.1.7), keeping sensorType rmsCurrent(1). The raw integer is divided by 10^decimalDigits. Absent, unmatched or unscalable rows are dropped.

metrics.name: pdu_inlet_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Per-inlet RMS voltage in volts from PDU2 measurementsInletSensorValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.13742.6.5.2.3.1.4) with inletSensorDecimalDigits (1.3.6.1.4.1.13742.6.3.3.4.1.7), keeping sensorType rmsVoltage(4). The raw integer is divided by 10^decimalDigits. Absent, unmatched or unscalable rows are dropped.

metrics.name: pdu_inlet_power_watts
metrics.description: Per-inlet active power in watts from PDU2 measurementsInletSensorValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.13742.6.5.2.3.1.4) with inletSensorDecimalDigits (1.3.6.1.4.1.13742.6.3.3.4.1.7), keeping sensorType activePower(5). The raw integer is divided by 10^decimalDigits. Absent, unmatched or unscalable rows are dropped.

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Per-sensor external temperature in degrees Celsius from PDU2 measurementsExternalSensorValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.13742.6.5.5.3.1.4) with externalSensorDecimalDigits (1.3.6.1.4.1.13742.6.3.6.3.1.17), keeping externalSensorType temperature(10). Fahrenheit (externalSensorUnits degreeF=14) is converted to Celsius and rounded to 0.1; degreeC=7 is kept. Rows with IsAvailable not true, State unavailable, units other than degreeC/degreeF, values outside -40..100 C, or missing scale are dropped.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Per-sensor external relative humidity in percent from PDU2 measurementsExternalSensorValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.13742.6.5.5.3.1.4) with externalSensorDecimalDigits (1.3.6.1.4.1.13742.6.3.6.3.1.17), keeping externalSensorType humidity(11). The raw integer is divided by 10^decimalDigits. Values outside 0-100 and absent rows are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
